apitoken.description: The API token for accessing Virtomize UII. If none is provided, the fallback is to use the environment variable `VIRTOMIZE_API_TOKEN`.

localstorage.description: The provider will store some data locally to work correctly. Use this parameter to overwrite the default location.

architecture.description: The architecture variant of the OS that should be installed. `32` or `64`. Defaults to `64`.

enable_ssh_authentication_through_passwo.description: If true, login into the OS through SSH will be enabled.

hostname.description: The host name to be configured during the installation

keyboard.description: The keyboard layout used for the OS. For example `en-en`. Defaults to English.

locale.description: The locale used for the OS. For example `en-en`. Defaults to English.

localpath.description: The path where the ISO is temporary cached after its creation.

dhcp.description: Specifies if the network should automatically retrieve its IP through and DHCP server.

dns.description: A list of DNS server for this network. Necessary only for non DHCP networks.

domain.description: The domain used for this network. Necessary only for non DHCP networks.

gateway.description: The gateway used for this network. Necessary only for non DHCP networks.

ip_net.description: The CIDR for this network, for example `198.51.100.0/22`, Necessary only for non DHCP networks.

mac.description: The mac address of the network card this network configuration should be applied to. Only necessary if more then one card is present.

no_internet.description: A flag indicating if this network does not have access to internet. At least one network needs internet access.

networks.description: A list of networks that should be configured. Must contain at least one network with internet access.

packages.description: A list of additional packages that should be installed in addition to the necessary ones.

password.description: A password to be set the `root` user. The default password if this parameter is not set is `virtomize`.

ssh_keys.description: A list of SSH keys to be installed for use with the SSH login.

timezone.description: The timezone to be used by the OS.

version.description: The version of the distribution, for example `11`
